checks.name: Pinned production kernels, scene bridge and exact native CPU recipe before context access
One new complete SH bake shared by both eyes and two fresh immediately consumed original-ray GPU T requests
Complete normal SDR composed image copied before yield and read only after healthy whole-frame timer
Precise installed native state restored BEFORE target recreation/disposal
Original semantic targets/dimensions/intent restored; history explicitly invalidated
All temporary method descriptors restored exactly

timedIntervals.scope: One complete fresh SDR scene plus matching-format capture; retrospective, not preemptive

limits: One actual fresh current-camera single-event transaction at160x171, original camera aspect and existing paused environment; small output does not reduce underlying scene geometry.

Scene-linear HDR is normally composed through lens.render({sdr:true}); HDR display transport/presentation excluded. Original HDR intent is restored; its normal original empty presentation is separately accounted by the root AFTER instrumentation ends.

Whole-frame timer includes photometry/cloud-cache, both opaque/volume/emitter views, complete fresh numerical fields, normal SDR postprocess and one image blit.100ms first-frame guard is retrospective and cannot preempt already submitted work. Cold instrumented submission is not a steady-state frame/FPS benchmark.
R29 independently admitted exact kernel numerics; this test proves coherent fresh production consumption and bounded image capture, not an all-pair online numerical oracle for the new camera.

Raw measurement state is restored only INSIDE the installed small scene before target recreation. Original Three target objects/dimensions and user intent are restored with recreated storage; caches/history/photometry are invalidated/recomputed, not bitwise restored.
Known two-event >4m per-kernel CPU cliff remains outside this one-event admission; no multi-event stress, source/matter thinning, stale optical result or whole-goal completion claim.

sourceT.model: full-SPD finite Gaussian extinction; unchanged64packet sums in exact rectangles then one complete increasing-tile reduction; no SH1/SSA/P/C
limits: No universalCPU1e-5 error guarantee; Float32 input/kernel/summation/exp require separate oracle admission.
Original-double reflection water-hit origins supplied by caller; normalised per-source ray, nearer endpoint reversal and cross-product perpendicular distance.

Each prepare replaces the borrowed T texture; sorted FW row ordering/sourceVersion must match and draw immediately. Only metadata.count output rows are valid; nonempty active-count requests may leave unused capacity texels stale.
Explicit complete-request and per-map policies; unsupported dispatch requires caller CPU fallback. Legacy-max is an incumbent two-pass QA comparator restricted to the old complete-request ceiling.
Fixed capabilities are cached for one live context; observed loss/replacement requires a new field before GPU reuse.

limits: Source bounds must cover all participating RGB channels and worst relevant overlap.
Finite FP16 storage and final display dynamic range are different constraints.
A changed storage exposure does not change photographic exposure.

weather.model: prescribed moist parcel LCL plus kinematic cumulus; no atmospheric fluid/forecast solve

limits: analytic rest-mesh wind and camera motion only; no arbitrary model-matrix animation
missing-coverage bridge retains conservative camera-only fallback

bloom.model: single threshold-free linear HDR PSF; opt-in affine ghost/veil share at most 1.8% radiance redistribution
bloom.flareScope: visible input image only; finite sensor crop, no offscreen-source/lens-tracing/occlusion inference

lens.antialias: MSAA + leaf temporal + water temporal + SMAA

temporal.scope: analytic wind/camera foliage motion, MSAA coverage, independent short water radiance history
temporal.metadata: R8 age; nearest valid depth, bilinear RGB

farField.model: shared spherical-Earth datum with logarithmic outer grid; analytic bed preserves local water depth

optics.reference: authored linear-RGB effective coefficients; clarity changes only suspended-particle scattering; not measured full-spectrum/NTU/Secchi data

submergedProps.model: finite real sphere bounds choose search intervals; real auxiliary RGB/depth verifies nearest wet ray hit; one-pixel finite-resolution tolerance
limits: Screen-visible auxiliary surfaces only; offscreen/occluded surfaces retain analytic bed without clamped sampling
